system_prompt: You are a careful causal discovery expert. Your task is to convert variable semantics into a plausible causal order prior. Do not claim that the order is ground truth. Return strict JSON only.
rationale: Membrane lipid substrates and upstream signaling enzymes plausibly precede kinase activation. PIP2 is upstream of PLC-gamma, while PIP3 is upstream of Akt. Raf-Mek-Erk is a canonical phosphorylation cascade. PKC and PKA are signaling activities that can feed into MAPK pathways, while p38 and Jnk are downstream stress MAPKs, so they are placed later.
